title.narrative: Enhancing ACET Capacity to strengthen African Govts for Transformation

description.narrative: The development objective of this IDF grant request is to enhance the capacity of the African Center for Economic Transformation (ACET) to leverage its growinganalytical work to strengthen policy and institutional strategies and capacities of African governments for transformation. This will be undertaken through advocacy and outreach, policy advice and deepening analysis and research in key transformative areas. Advocacy and outreach activities will aim to bring ACET’s insights and perspectives on transformation to the widest array of relevant actors,especially policy makers and the private sector who will make transformation happen. The IDF will also strengthen ACET’s capacity to serve as policy coach to selected governments in enhancing institutional capacities and in managing extractive resources for transformation.# # The main components and activities of this initiative include:# (A) Advocacy and knowledge-sharing for capacity building:# (i) Editing, publishing and dissemination of various reports. The reports include the African Transformation Report (ATR), country case studies, thematic studies and industry # studies. # (ii) Capacity Building Events. ACET will convene a number of events to share the findings of its research with policy makers and other stakeholders. # (B) Policy advice and implementation support in the extractive sector # (i) Liberia: Revising Petroleum Legislatives# (ii) Guinea- Provide Strategic Support to the Technical and Strategic Committees responsible for the Review of Mining Contracts.# (iii) Zambia- Study on Building the Institutional Capacity of the Mining Sector.# (C) Policy studies in the extractive sector# (i) Local Content Studies# (ii) Value Addition Studies# The envisaged outcomes are:# (i) Increased awareness and understanding by policy makers and other stakeholders of economic transformation issues in Africa, and recognition of ACET’s perspectives on various themes relating to economic transformation in Africa.# (ii) Effective policies and strategies geared towards strengthening institutional capacity for economic transformation in Africa# (iii) Better understanding of the drivers of success of local content and valueaddition policies spurring policymakers to formulate informed policies in the extractive sector.
